title: Beeraha Barwaaqada ee Baaba'aya
intro: Dhul ay ku barakeysan yihiin nimco badan, bulsho ayaa ku barwaaqoobay, iyagoo ku nool calaamado nimco rabbaani ah. Barwaaqadoodu waxay markhaati u ahayd nimcada Rabbigood, hadiyad loogu talagalay in lagu dhiirrigeliyo mahadnaq iyo addeecid. Haddana, inkastoo ay jiraan tilmaamo cad oo ku saabsan nimcooyinkooda, haddana waxaa yimid isbeddel, oo caqabad ku ah qaddarintooda isha hantidooda iyo raaxada badan.
clues: Waxaa nalagu barakeeyay laba beerood, mid midig iyo mid bidix, oo ay ku badan yihiin wax soo saar.
Waxaa nala faray inaan wax ka cunno rizqiga Rabbigeen oo aan ugu mahadnaqno dhul wanaagsan iyo Rabbi dambi dhaafa.
Waan isla weynay oo waxaan ka leexannay waddada mahadnaqa, annagoo ku faannay maalkeenna iyo awooddeenna.
Waxaan ka dalbanay Rabbigeen inuu kordhiyo masaafada u dhaxaysa safarradeenna, isagoo muujinaya quudhsiga fudud ee uu bixiyay.
Waxaa naga digay rasuul, laakiin waan diidnay fariinta oo waxaan sii wadnay dayacaaddeenna.
Biyo-xidheenkii weynaa, kaas oo ilaalinayay barwaaqadeenna, ugu dambayntii wuu jabay, taasoo keentay daad ba'an.

options: Waxaa naloo beddelay daanyeerro iyo doofaarro
Waa nala badbaadiyay oo waxaan u guurnay dhul cusub
Waan kala firirnay, dhulkeenniina wuxuu noqday mid aan cidlo ahayn

outcome.answer: Waan kala firirnay, dhulkeenniina wuxuu noqday mid aan cidlo ahayn

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
